title: AI Enablement Workshops for Procurement Teams
venue: Avis Budget Group — US & UK Procurement
description: Designed and led live AI enablement workshops for the US and UK Procurement teams: practical LLM application, the Context → Task → Format prompting framework, the jagged-frontier model for deciding which tasks to hand to AI versus keep human, and responsible-use ground rules — with live demos on core procurement workflows like RFP response triage, contract summarization, and supplier-risk briefings.
